question: Who among the following devised a policy that came to be known as the Doctrine of Lapse?
solution: The correct answer is __**Option 1**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • ** The Doctrine of Lapse was a policy introduced by Lord Dalhousie**, who was the Governor-General of India from 1848 to 1856, during the period of British colonial rule in India. • The doctrine stated that if an Indian ruler, such as a prince or a king, died without a natural heir, his territory would "lapse" or be annexed by the British East India Company. • The doctrine was intended to expand British control over Indian states and territories and was one of the factors that contributed to the Indian Rebellion of **1857.**
